title: Farashin fakitinku, yi kyau sosai kuma ku yarda a rubuce
course_title: Muhimman Abubuwan Kyauta: Kunshin, Farashi da Bayar da Aikin Biyan Kuɗi

say: Farashin fakitinku, yi kyau sosai, kuma ku yarda kowane aiki a rubuce.
Wannan shi ne bidiyon don module na biyu na Freelancing Fundamentals.
Abokan ciniki ba safai suke son siyan sa'o'i. Suna son a gama sakamako. Amma bayan kowane farashi kuna buƙatar lamba ɗaya kawai kuna gani: mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ku na sa'a.

say: Kuma za ku yarda da kowane aiki a rubuce kafin ku fara.

panel.heading: Daga gwaninta zuwa aikin biya
items: Pitch a cikin gajeren sassa hudu
Yarda da iyaka da ajiya tukuna

say: Mafi ƙarancin kuɗin ku shine mafi ƙarancin adadin kowane sa'a na aiki wanda ke kiyaye kasuwancin ku a raye. Ga yadda Amaka ke aiki.
Na farko, manufar samun kudin shiga. Tana so ta rika kai wa gida kusan Naira 250,000 duk wata.
Na biyu, ta ƙara farashin kasuwanci: bayanai, wutar lantarki da man fetur, da adanawa don kwamfutar tafi-da-gidanka. Wato 40,000.
Tare Naira 290,000 ne.
Na uku, ta raba da sa'o'inta 72 da za a iya biya. Wato kimanin naira 4,028 ne, wanda takan kai kusan 4,100 a awa daya.
Kwatantai ashirin suna ɗaukar ta kusan awanni 8 tare da dubawa da bita. 8 sau 4,100 shine 32,800, don haka ta siyar da kunshin akan naira 35,000.
Girman girma uku suna taimaka wa abokin ciniki ya zaɓi nawa zai saya, maimakon ko ya saya kwata-kwata. Basic shine bayanin kwatance 10 akan kusan naira 18,000.

panel.heading: Na asali, ma'auni da ƙima
items: Premium: 30 ƙari Game da mu, bita 2, 55,000
Faɗin abin da ba a haɗa ba

say: Ma'auni shine bayanin 20 don kusan 35,000. Abokan ciniki da yawa suna karɓar fakitin tsakiya, don haka sanya shi shine wanda kuke son siyarwa.

panel.heading: Na asali, ma'auni da ƙima
items: Premium: 30 ƙari Game da mu, bita 2, 55,000
Faɗin abin da ba a haɗa ba

say: Premium yana ƙara ƙarin aiki da zagaye na biyu na bita, don kusan 55,000. Bincika kowane farashi akan mafi ƙarancin ƙimar ku.

panel.heading: Na asali, ma'auni da ƙima
items: Premium: 30 ƙari Game da mu, bita 2, 55,000
Faɗin abin da ba a haɗa ba

say: Kowane fakiti kuma yakamata ya faɗi abin da ke wajensa, misali ɗaukar hoto ba a haɗa shi ba. Wannan yana kare ku lokacin da ƙaramin ƙarin shine ainihin sabon aiki.

panel.heading: Na asali, ma'auni da ƙima
items: Premium: 30 ƙari Game da mu, bita 2, 55,000
Faɗin abin da ba a haɗa ba

say: Manufar saƙo ɗaya ba shine rufe siyarwa ba. Domin samun amsa.
Misali, Ifeoma a Enugu ta rubuta wa gidan burodin gida. Ta lura da kek ɗin su ba su da farashi ko matakan oda.

panel.heading: Fitilar kashi huɗu
items: Bayar da sabis mai tsabta guda ɗaya

say: Ta ba da sabis guda ɗaya: gajerun bayanan Instagram waɗanda suka haɗa da farashi, girman da matakin tsari mai sauƙi.

panel.heading: Fitilar kashi huɗu
items: Bayar da sabis mai tsabta guda ɗaya

say: Ta nuna hujja tare da hanyar haɗin samfurin ɗaya, ba tarihin rayuwarta gaba ɗaya ba.

panel.heading: Fitilar kashi huɗu
items: Bayar da sabis mai tsabta guda ɗaya

say: Kuma ta nemi ƙaramin eh: shin zan iya sake rubutawa uku daga cikin taken ku, ba tare da tsada ba? Riƙe samfuran kyauta kaɗan, kusan mintuna 30 zuwa 45 a mafi yawan.

panel.heading: Fitilar kashi huɗu
items: Bayar da sabis mai tsabta guda ɗaya

say: Mutane masu aiki suna rasa saƙonni. Bi sau ɗaya bayan kwanaki 3 ko 4, aika bayanin kula na ƙarshe bayan mako guda, sannan ci gaba. Mutunta kowa ba nan da nan.

panel.heading: Fitilar kashi huɗu
items: Bayar da sabis mai tsabta guda ɗaya
panel.rule: Bi bayan kwana 3 ko 4, sau ɗaya kuma, sannan a daina

say: Bayan ɗan gajeren kiran ganowa, inda kuka ƙara tambaya kuma ku yi ƙasa da magana, aika rubutaccen iyaka a rana guda. Girma yana nufin ainihin abin da aikin ya haɗa.

panel.heading: Rubuta iyakar
items: Abin da abokin ciniki ke bayarwa

say: Yi lissafin abubuwan da za a iya bayarwa, abin da abokin ciniki ke bayarwa, ranar ƙarshe da sake dubawa, abin da ba a haɗa shi ba, farashin farashi da sharuɗɗan biyan kuɗi, da kuma wanda ke da aikin ƙarshe.
Ƙarshe da: idan wannan daidai ne, da fatan za a ba da amsa Agreed kuma aika ajiya, kuma zan fara.

panel.heading: Rubuta iyakar
items: Abin da abokin ciniki ke bayarwa

say: Bayyanar Yarjejeniyar a rubuce shine rikodin ku na yarjejeniyar.

say: Adadi wani ɓangare ne na biyan kuɗi kafin farawa. Yawancin masu zaman kansu suna tambayar sababbin abokan ciniki don kashi 50 a gaba, da ma'auni kafin fayiloli na ƙarshe.

say: Sai kawai a fara aikin biya.

panel.heading: Babu ajiya, babu farawa
items: Amsoshin abokin ciniki sun yarda a rubuce
An tabbatar da ajiya a cikin app ɗin ku

say: Yi la'akari da girman kai, lokacin da aiki ke girma a hankali ta hanyar ƙananan buƙatun. Zainab a Abuja ta amince da mukamai 12 akan naira 60,000. Lokacin da abokin ciniki ya nemi a ba shi fosta da ƙarin posts 3, sai ta aika da bukatar canjin naira 27,000, kuma abokin ciniki ya amince.

panel.heading: Babu ajiya, babu farawa
items: Amsoshin abokin ciniki sun yarda a rubuce
An tabbatar da ajiya a cikin app ɗin ku
panel.rule: Amsa kowane ƙarin buƙatar da kyau, sannan farashi

say: Don tunawa. Adadin ku shine burin ku tare da farashi, wanda aka raba ta sa'o'i masu ƙididdigewa. Fakitin farashin daga sa'o'in ku, an tattara su.
Pitch a cikin gajeren sassa hudu. Sami iyakar rubutu da ajiya kafin aiki. Kuma farashin kowane ƙarin buƙatun.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Farashin fakiti = awoyi x ƙimar, tarawa
Pitch: sanarwa, tayin, hujja, ƙaramin mataki
Rubutun iyaka da ajiya kafin aiki

say: Yanzu gina takardar farashin ku tare da fakiti uku, aika filaye goma na farko, kuma ƙirƙirar samfuri mai iyaka.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
